title: HitFloat
description: Clean floating damage numbers with critical-hit visuals for Forge 1.16.5.
body:
# HitFloat

HitFloat adds clean floating damage numbers when entities are hit.

## Features
- Floating damage numbers above hit entities
- Smooth rise animation and automatic cleanup
- Critical hit highlight text and particle burst
- Configurable thresholds, lifetime, speed, and particle intensity
- Built-in safety cap for active floating texts

## Configuration
Generated config file: `config/hitfloat-common.toml`

Main options:
- `enabled`
- `showOnlyPlayerHits`
- `showAgainstPlayers`
- `minDamageToDisplay`
- `lifetimeTicks`
- `risePerTick`
- `criticalParticleBurst`
- `maxActiveFloats`

## Compatibility
- Minecraft: 1.16.5
- Loader: Forge
- Java: 8+ (runtime), Java 17 recommended for local build tooling
